body.name: rhoOcc
body.construction: For dyadic \(h\), set \(K_h=h^{-d}\), \(p_{h,j}=P_X(B_{h,j})\), \(\chi_{n,h,j}=1-(1-p_{h,j})^n-np_{h,j}(1-p_{h,j})^{n-1}\), and \(\Gamma_n(h;P_X)=\{K_h/\sum_{j=1}^{K_h}\chi_{n,h,j}\}^{1/2}\). Define the candidate uniform radius \(\rho_n^{\mathrm{occ}}=n^{-1/2}\vee\sup_{P_X:\,c_X\le f_X\le C_X}\inf_{h\in\{2^{-m}:m\in\mathbb N\}}\{h^t+n^{-1}K_h^{1/2}\Gamma_n(h;P_X)\}\).
